context: This scene takes place at the player’s camp shortly after the Creche: Lae'zel has just been recruited, is infected by the tadpole, and remains distrustful and ready to fight. Kith'rak Voss — a furious, smarmy, oddly fatherly Githyanki who served Prince Orpheus and recently appeared during the bridge/Chokepoint events — arrives unannounced, kneels in a Githyanki sign of submission, and claims to be there to help end Vlaakith’s rule. He knows the player carries the Astral Prism and insists its hidden tenant can topple Vlaakith, asking Lae'zel to bring the Prism to Baldur’s Gate (Sharess’ Caress) to further his plan. Companions react warily and Lae'zel’s response can range from agreeing to meet him to attacking him; whether Voss proves ally or enemy later hinges on choices tied to Orpheus.
